description: 🍪 9 Delicious Cookies 1️⃣ Chocolate Chip Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup flour • 1/2 cup butter • 1/2 cup brown sugar • 1 egg • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 1/2 tsp baking soda • 1 cup chocolate chips 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix butter and sugar. 2. Add egg and vanilla. 3. Stir in dry ingredients. 4. Fold in chocolate chips. 5. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 2️⃣ Peanut Butter Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup peanut butter • 1/2 cup sugar • 1/2 cup brown sugar • 1 egg • 1 tsp vanilla • 1/2 tsp baking powder 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix all ingredients. 2. Form balls and flatten with a fork. 3. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 3️⃣ Oatmeal Raisin Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup oats • 3/4 cup flour • 1/2 cup brown sugar • 1/4 cup sugar • 1/2 cup butter • 1/2 cup raisins • 1 tsp cinnamon • 1/2 tsp baking soda 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix wet ingredients. 2. Add dry ingredients and raisins. 3. Scoop onto baking sheet. 4. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 4️⃣ Double Chocolate Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup flour • 1/2 cup butter • 1/2 cup sugar • 1/3 cup cocoa powder • 1 egg • 1/2 tsp baking soda • 1 cup chocolate chips 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix butter, sugar and egg. 2. Add dry ingredients. 3. Fold in chocolate chips. 4. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 5️⃣ Snickerdoodle Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 3/4 cups flour • 1/2 cup butter • 3/4 cup sugar • 1 egg • 1 tsp cream of tartar • 1/2 tsp baking soda • Cinnamon sugar mix 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Make dough. 2. Roll into balls. 3. Coat with cinnamon sugar. 4. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 6️⃣ White Chocolate Macadamia Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup flour • 1/2 cup butter • 1/3 cup sugar • 1/2 cup brown sugar • 1 egg • 3/4 cup white chocolate chips • 1/2 cup macadamia nuts 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix dough. 2. Add chocolate chips and nuts. 3. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 7️⃣ Thumbprint Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 cup flour • 1/2 cup butter • 1/4 cup sugar • 1 egg yolk • 1/2 tsp vanilla • Jam of choice 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Make dough and roll into balls. 2. Press center with thumb. 3. Fill with jam. 4. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 8️⃣ M&M Cookies 🛒 Ingredients • 1 1/2 cups flour • 1/2 cup butter • 1/2 cup brown sugar • 1/4 cup sugar • 1 egg • 1 cup M&M’s 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix dough. 2. Fold in M&M’s. 3. Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 10–12 minutes. 9️⃣ Coconut Macaroons 🛒 Ingredients • 2 1/2 cups shredded coconut • 2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk • 1 tsp vanilla extract • 2 egg whites 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Mix all ingredients. 2. Scoop onto baking sheet. 3. Bake at 325°F (165°C) for 15–18 minutes until golden. #cookies #cookierecipe #baking #dessert #easyrecipes
